name: Rue
description: Nineteen-year-old netrunner in a hanger under the Spine's deck. Good, broke, and being recruited by a man she's sure is SDG.
tagline: Netrunner, nineteen. Lives over the drop. Hasn't said yes.

facts.label: KNOWN FOR
facts.value: A clean Voltaic run nobody should have seen.

facts.label: DANGEROUS
facts.value: Nine thousand in arrears. Desperate people say yes.

outfitWears.work: her dead father's oversized olive hauler's jacket with a reflective stripe, sleeves rolled, grey hoodie, patched black cargo trousers, boots a size too big, fingerless gloves, a pocket deck on a strap

standing.want: Out of debt without owing anyone for it, and the truth about what happened to the last runner SDG bought.
standing.secret: Your real name is Marit. Your father was the last person who used it, and nobody on the Spine has said it since.
standing.hint: that Rue isn't the name you were born with, and who last used the real one

soren.line: Rue. A nineteen-year-old runner in a hanger under the deck between Forty and Forty-One. She went into a Voltaic route table three months ago and the branch noticed; you're the one sent to buy her. Nine thousand in her dead father's arrears. Good, broke, and she hasn't said yes.

oksana.line: Rue. The hanger girl, Danylo Lysenko's daughter; you've fed her since she was small, and since he died on the deck you've kept her tab and never added it up. She comes down for fried dumplings at six.
